author: incidence-engine
body_markdown: The exact-audited balanced-color construction forces every cover reaching half of every accepted line to have $|R|=\Omega(p/\epsilon)$, despite an immediate constant decoder. Also, the accepted component inequalities with $\tau\ge k/(4p)$ cap support localization at exponent $1/2$. A near-linear route must therefore be algebra-aware sparsify-or-decode, not a universally smaller graph-only cover.
subject: Graph-only ceiling
